 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0},
                    key=lambda color: min(c for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color))
    objs = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        top, left = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
        bottom, right = max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        mask = {(r-top, c-left) for r, c in cells}
        objs.append((color, bottom-top+1, right-left+1, mask))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    for color, oh, ow, mask in objs:
        for dr, dc in mask:
            if top+dr < h and left+dc < w:
                out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
        top += oh-1
        left += ow-1
    return out
"
